title: Moving Your NBS Chorus Office Master to Avoice | Avoice
summary: What carries over when a practice moves its NBS Chorus office master to Avoice, what gets better, and what to tidy up before the switch.
body_markdown:
05


## Run the first project in parallel


Don't switch everything at once. Pick one live project at Stage 3 or early Stage 4, draft its specification from the migrated master in Avoice, and compare it with what your current process would have produced.


FIG. 02


**A move measured in weeks**


One pilot project shows whether the migrated master holds up before any other team depends on it.


During the pilot, track three things: how long the first full draft took, how many clauses the technical director had to correct, and how many of those corrections were house-style issues the rules should have caught. Turn every repeated correction into a rule before the next project starts.


Time the switch to your Chorus renewal date. If you still have months left on a contract, talk to us about how to bridge the gap so you aren't paying twice.
